text:
Zoe: Heads-up — we've got 48h to produce a battlecard + landing ad tiles for the launch webinar. Need: 2 headline experiments, 3 benchmark claims (legal-friendly), and a 1-page SDR crib.
Malik: Understood. Audience segments: devs, infra, procurement. Tone: technical -> devs, econ-first -> procurement.
Priya: Bench candidates: p95 latency under typical chat workload; cost-per-1k tokens under mixed workload; predictable failover time with fallback models. Use conservative language (ranges/qualifiers).
SalesOps: Routing rules: webinar leads -> tag "webinar_q3"; if score>=85 or company_tier==enterprise route to AE; else SDR. Can we have numeric thresholds?
Zoe: Yes. Draft rule: 
```
if utm_campaign == \"webinar_q3\" and lead_score >= 85:
  route: AE
elif utm_campaign == \"webinar_q3\":
  route: SDR
```
Malik: Battlecard snippets (<=18 words):
- Cloud AI platforms: \"Broad services; inference economics vary with production mixes.\" Support: \"Cost variance observed at p95 depending on workload.\"
- LLM APIs: \"Easy to start; limited rollout & cache primitives.\" Support: \"Most lack built-in KV-cache and pinning.\"
- Infra vendors: \"Control at hardware level; building serving runtime still required.\" Support: \"Teams reimplement batching/quantization to reach SLOs.\"
Priya: Headlines for A/B test: A) \"Serve reliably. Cut inference waste.\" B) \"Same API, lower cost, safer rollouts.\" Keep 6-word ad variants too.
Design-bot: Putting hero slide + 3 social tiles in Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz/launch-v6
Legal: We allow \"lower cost\" or \"predictable\" if footnote: \"based on internal benchmarks on representative workloads; results vary.\" We'll add the exact footnote copy.
SalesOps: SDR crib: 3 quick rebut lines + 30s demo ask template. Example rebut: \"We already use cloud X\" -> \"We complement cloud infra; routing and caching reduce runtime spend without ripping anything out.\"
Zoe: Timeline: drafts in 6 hours. Meet at 9am tomorrow for copy lock, then hand to design. Tag me when dropped. :rocket:
